sources.title: Q3 FY2026 issuer results
sources.supports: Q3 revenue $9.12bn, GAAP operating income $3.08bn at 33.7%, non-GAAP operating income $3.10bn at 34.0%, and operating cash flow $3.04bn

sources.title: Annual report / financial results
sources.supports: latest financial anchor used in packet

financial_anchor.caveat: FY2025 GAAP operating income governs the annual pre-tax screen; Q3 FY2026 is current context and is not annualized.

ai_claim.claim: AIx combines process tools, sensors, metrology, analytics and ML to accelerate process development.
ai_claim.stage: E1 product/platform; production expectation not verified
ai_claim.limitation: Quoted expectation that algorithms will be ported to production is forward-looking, not measured deployment.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: Lam Research and customer internal process-control teams and specialist analytics vendors can replicate tools or force gains through to customers.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Competitive capability does not by itself prove equal outcomes.

rights_limit: Fab recipes, wafers and yield data are customer-sensitive. Service access can support customer-specific inference, but public documents do not establish broad cross-fab reuse rights.
materiality_summary: Five percent of FY2025 GAAP operating income is $414.5m on an annual pre-tax basis; public evidence does not establish an AI-attributed amount.

arithmetic.inputs: FY2025 GAAP operating income $8.29bn; 5%; illustrative eligible service/operations pool $3bn, efficiency 10%, realization 60%, retention 50%, recurring cost $70m
arithmetic.result: Illustrative $20m is below the $414.5m annual pre-tax hurdle; customer yield savings are not Applied Materials cost savings.

g2_provisional: Open: E1/E2 evidence supports measurement, but E3 quality-adjusted causality and E4 cash retention are not established.
unresolved_questions: What share of eligible workload is in production?
What controlled quality-adjusted KPI result exists?
What do contracts permit for pooled learning and how much benefit is retained after recurring cost?
